name: Hive 1.5.3
notes: Diagnostics for agent turns: the runtime now logs each turn's dispatch (provider, model, working dir, isolation) and its outcome (completed / failed / timed out), plus the exact CLI spawn — so a hung or misconfigured agent shows up in Settings -> Diagnostics instead of being an invisible 'thinking...'. Also fixes running an agent when no workspace folder is set (an empty working directory used to fail the spawn).
